incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sustained GPU queue growth in aws-us-west-2; autoscaler returning provisioning errors and quota responses. Trigger threshold: p95 tokens >1s for 3m.

Alex (oncall): paging. seeing sudden queue spike on serving-prod-3, p95 ~1400ms. autoscaler logs are full of capacity/quotas. tagging @Tara.

Tara (cloud): confirmed from cloud side: AWS returns CapacityError in us-west-2a and API QuotaLimitExceeded in us-west-2b for GPU instance family. Some AZs hit soft limits for GPU-family. Opening SR.

Sam (runtime): autoscaler tail:
```
E0412 09:02:11 autoscaler.go:331] ProvisionRequest failed: CapacityError: InsufficientInstanceCapacity: No GPU instances available in us-west-2a
E0412 09:02:12 autoscaler.go:332] quota_error: QuotaExceeded: RequestLimit exceeded for requested GPU cores
```

Maya (engops): quick mitigation plan: 1) apply tenant-level soft rate limits, 2) short-circuit large-model routes to smaller variants for non-SLA tenants, 3) failover canary traffic to aws-us-east-1. I'll start route change unless objections.

Alex (oncall): do it. Also reduce background batch job concurrency for now.

Nina (cs): heads up — two paying customers (QuantFlow, BrightBank) reported elevated latencies and retries. I'm drafting a message.

deploy-bot: deploy started: throttle-config v2 -> gateway (migrated by Maya).

Maya (engops): deployed a soft throttle on api-gateway (40% reduce) for free-tier keys and background jobs. Command: `kubectl apply -f emergency-throttle.yaml -n api`

Sam (runtime): spinning up smaller GPU instances (g4dn.xlarge) in us-west-2 while we wait on quota increase. If those come up, scheduler will rebalance kvcaches.

Tara (cloud): support case created: AWS SR-558121: "Request GPU instance quota bump + capacity check". Link: https://console.aws.amazon.com/support/cases#/case/?caseId=SR-558121. Also requested expedited review.

Alex (oncall): handing escalation to Bob for long-duration tracking. I'll remain for context for 20m. @Bob please take lead.

Bob (oncall): taking. I'll coordinate with Tara and cloud, and open a dedicated capacity pool for top-tier tenants to avoid noisy neighbors. Also adding an incident Jira: INC-1984.

Sam (runtime): temporary routing rule pushed to redirect traffic for model rwd-8x -> rwd-4x for non-enterprise keys. Added prefix-cache warmers for rwd-4x to reduce cold-start impact.

Maya (engops): added cross-region failover policy in routing: if region=="aws-us-west-2" and queue_depth>1000 then forward to aws-us-east-1 with per-tenant tag preservation. Pushing metrics to dashboard.

Alex (oncall): noticed control-plane kube API ratebacks; restarted placement-controller to clear backlog. Safe restart.

Tara (cloud): AWS increased soft limit temporarily (+12 GPUs) while SR in progress. Provisioning picking up 6/8 pending nodes. Monitoring.

incident-bot: Update: queue depth decreased 37% in 8m after throttles + fallback. p95 down to ~720ms. Remaining: tail p99 for rwd-8x.

Nina (cs): customer comms: sent initial note to QuantFlow & BrightBank offering traffic shift and SLA credit if needed. Both requested we move critical jobs to Dedicated if instability continues. Logged impacted spans.

Sam (runtime): follow-ups: 1) add quota-aware autoscaler behavior (fail fast + trigger cross-region earlier), 2) implement automatic model-level fallback at 2x tail threshold, 3) create playbook for burst capacity using smaller instance families across AZs.

Bob (oncall): note for postmortem: check muted alerts, confirm why autoscaler didn't trigger cross-region sooner, review kube autoscaler error handling for quota responses.

Maya (engops): collecting logs and route traces now. Creating an incident retro doc and first draft in 36h.

Tara (cloud): will follow up on SR and request permanent quota increase. Also exploring using provider partner for overflow in the region.

Alex (oncall): handing routine oncall to Carol in 1h; Bob will remain primary incident lead until quota is stable.

incident-bot: INCIDENT STATE: mitigated (partial). Actions open: quota confirmation, capacity validation, postmortem. Owners: Sam (runtime), Maya (ops), Tara (cloud), Nina (cs). :white_check_mark:
